name: Sanction of Adult Sticks to Senior Citizens
teBrief: "సీనియర్ సిటిజన్లకు వయోజన కర్రలను మంజూరు చేయడం" పథకం సీనియర్ సిటిజన్లకు నడక కర్రలను అందించడం లక్ష్యంగా పెట్టుకుంది.
brief: The "Sanction of Adult Sticks to Senior Citizens" scheme aims to provide walking sticks to senior citizens. This initiative ensures that eligible senior citizens receive the necessary support to enhance their mobility and independence.
briefFull: The "Sanction of Adult Sticks to Senior Citizens" scheme aims to provide walking sticks to senior citizens. This initiative ensures that eligible senior citizens receive the necessary support to enhance their mobility and independence.
details: The "Sanction of Adult Sticks to Senior Citizens" scheme aims to provide walking sticks to senior citizens. The A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance Corporation, Andhra Pradesh, under its Action Plan 2017-18. The walking sticks are distributed by the Assistant Directors, Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled & Senior Citizens, and District Managers, A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance Corporation.
benefits: - Eligible beneficiaries of this scheme will be provided with a DAISY Player to facilitate accessible learning and information access.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should have 40% or above disability and meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the [RPwD Act, 2016](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3e58aea67b01fa747687f038dfde066f6/uploads/2023/10/202310161053958942.pdf).1. The applicant should be eligible for sanction only once in three years.
1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-.
howToApply:
[Online]
**Step 01:** Visit the official website: [https://apdascac.ap.gov.in](https://apdascac.ap.gov.in)
**Step 02:** On the homepage, click on "[APDASCAC Schemes](https://apdascac.ap.gov.in/APDASCAC-Schemes/)".
**Step 03:** Select the "SANCTION OF ADULT STICKS" option.
**Step 04:** Click on "[Apply Now](https://apdascac.ap.gov.in/Forms/adult-sticks/)" to begin the application process.
**Step 05:** Fill in the required details and submit your application.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to receive a walking stick under this scheme?
faqs.a:
To be eligible for the DAISY Player Sanction Scheme, the applicant must meet the following criteria:

1. The applicant should have 40% or above disability and must fulfill the eligibility conditions as specified under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016.
1. The applicant is eligible for sanction only once in three years.
1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed ₹3.00 lakhs.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకం కింద వాకింగ్ స్టిక్ పొందడానికి ఎవరు అర్హులు?

faqs.q: How often can a person receive an adult stick under this scheme?
faqs.a: The benefit can be sanctioned once every three years.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకం కింద ఒక వ్యక్తి ఎంత తరచుగా వయోజన కర్రను పొందవచ్చు?

faqs.q: What documents are required to apply for a walking stick?
faqs.a:
Applicants must submit the following documents:

1. Age proof (only in case of senior citizens)
1. Aadhaar Card
1. Caste Certificate (for SC/ST/BC applicants)
1. Passport size photograph
1. Latest Income Certificate or BPL Ration Card
faqs.qTe: వాకింగ్ స్టిక్ కోసం దరఖాస్తు చేయడానికి ఏ పత్రాలు అవసరం?

faqs.q: Is this scheme only for senior citizens?
faqs.a: No, the scheme is open to all eligible persons with disabilities. However, senior citizens must provide age proof to avail the benefit.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకం కేవలం సీనియర్ సిటిజన్లకు మాత్రమేనా?

faqs.q: Who is responsible for distributing the walking sticks?
faqs.a: The walking sticks are distributed through the Assistant Directors and District Managers of the respective departments.
faqs.qTe: నడక కర్రలను పంపిణీ చేసే బాధ్యత ఎవరిది?

faqs.q: What measures are in place to prevent double or false claims?
faqs.a: Records of beneficiaries are maintained to avoid double or false claims, and verification is conducted before approval.
faqs.qTe: డబుల్ లేదా తప్పుడు క్లెయిమ్లను నివారించడానికి ఏ చర్యలు ఉన్నాయి?

faqs.q: Can the walking stick be transferred to another person?
faqs.a: No, the walking stick is issued to the individual and is non-transferable.
faqs.qTe: నడక కర్రను మరొక వ్యక్తికి బదిలీ చేయవచ్చా?

faqs.q: Is there an application deadline for receiving a walking stick?
faqs.a: Applications are received throughout the year, and eligible requests are processed as they come.
faqs.qTe: నడక కర్రను స్వీకరించడానికి దరఖాస్తు గడువు ఉందా?

faqs.q: What happens if the walking stick is damaged or requires maintenance?
faqs.a: Maintenance and repair responsibilities are usually not covered by the scheme; beneficiaries should refer to the guidelines or contact the distribution office for specific assistance.
faqs.qTe: వాకింగ్ స్టిక్ దెబ్బతిన్నట్లయితే లేదా నిర్వహణ అవసరమైతే ఏమి జరుగుతుంది?

faqs.q: What are the legal implications if incorrect information is found in the application at a later date?
faqs.a: The beneficiary is liable for legal action by the Corporation and must return the walking stick or the cost of the instrument.
faqs.qTe: తరువాతి తేదీలో దరఖాస్తులో తప్పుడు సమాచారం కనుగొనబడితే చట్టపరమైన చిక్కులు ఏమిటి?
